text:
Ruth: Emergency unfreeze request for eu slice to push v3.4.2-oompatch. Scoped to model-serving subgroup only. Proposed window 12:30-12:45 UTC. Need SRE + QA green. @Tom @Maya
Tom: Acknowledged. Quick checklist incoming. Key risks: cold-start burst, KV-cache warmup, embeddings mem spike.
Maya: QA can run targeted regression suite. ETA for initial smoke ~7m after canary up.
Liam: I'll own canary ramp and metrics. Plan: 3% canary eu-west-1, observe 6m. Abort: errors >= 0.8% OR p99 > 800ms OR memory alarm on any GPU node.
Ruth: Keep rollout tight. No other merges during this window.
Tom: Infra prechecks: node groups stable :white_check_mark:, autoscaler responsive :white_check_mark:, disk pressure OK :white_check_mark:. GPU mem headroom 22% (ok).
Tom: Observability hooks set: tracing, prometheus alerts, and a temporary dashboard for v3.4.2 tags.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot received unfreeze request from Ruth. Starting canary: v3.4.2-oompatch -> eu-canary-a (3%).
deploy-bot: Canary instances provisioning, health checks running.
Liam: Starting smoke (script below) once canary reports healthy.
Liam: ```
# quick_smoke.sh
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://eu-api.redwood.dev/v1/generate" \
  -d '{"prompt":"smoke","max_tokens":8}'
```
Maya: Smoke result: 200 OK, sample outputs valid, p95 145ms. No immediate regressions.
Tom: Monitoring 6m window now. Hard abort: any GPU OOM event, any 5xx spike > 1%. Soft abort: sustained latency degradation p95 > 700ms (requires quick triage).
Ruth: Documenting rollback play: pin to v3.4.1, run `deploy-bot rollback --slice eu --to v3.4.1` then `./roll_traffic_back.sh eu 100`. Whoever triggers rollback, ping #incidents and keep channel updated.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics @6m: errors 0.05%, p95 152ms, no GPU OOMs detected. Canary healthy.
Liam: Moving to 30% now.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 30% complete. Traffic redistributed.
Maya: Post-30% smoke passes. One flaky test in embedding path flagged but within tolerance.
Tom: Embeddings team on standby to pause calls if cost/latency climbs. Alert thresholds configured.
Ruth: Approving lift of freeze for this subgroup only. Confirmed no schema/data migrations.
Liam: Scheduling final ramp to 100% in 90s.
deploy-bot: Rolling to 100%... done. v3.4.2-oompatch live in eu.
Maya: QA will run expedited regression suite over next 30m. Will report any anomalies.
Tom: Added short-term watchlist: GPU mem, p99 latency, errors, token throughput. Alerts go to oncall and paged if critical.
Ruth: I'll add a note to release notes: one-line about OOM patch + rollback link. Also marking freeze-lift event on calendar.
Maya: Filing a short postmortem template entry in case any regressions appear.
Liam: Great job. Stand down unless we see anything noisy.
Ruth: :raised_hands: Thanks all.
